name: Communities Working for Nature Recovery
summary: Capital grants of up to £5,000, covering up to 100% of costs, for community groups doing practical nature recovery inside the Bannau Brycheiniog (Brecon Beacons) National Park, such as wildflower areas, hedgerows, woodland work and invasive species control.

calls.label: Second round

status.quote: Bannau Brycheiniog National Park is inviting applications from community groups and landowners who want to undertake practical and positive local nature recovery projects. Work from the first round of funding must be completed by 17 March 2026. Second round of grant funding runs until March 2027.

calls.note: No application deadline is stated; the second round runs until March 2027

applicant_types.quote: Grants of up to £5,000 for community groups who want to undertake practical and positive local nature recovery projects.

geography.quote: Sites must be within the National Park boundary.
